profile.headline: Senior Research and Development Engineer at Gamma Technologies, LLC
profile.summary:
I have more of a generalist experience. Developed software for embedded systems, desktop, backend, client-server and mainframes. My roles have include from being a contributor to technological leading up to some management.  I'm experienced with embedded Real-Time systems, windows, Linux and even some OpenVMS.  

Specialties: C/C++, TCP/IP, HTTP, SQL, Javascript, PERL, Python, Java, Rust

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Maintaining and developing support for the Fixed Income databases.  The technologies involved in this project are Bash, PERL, C++, MySQL (SQL), Python.

* Worked with a international team to port our C++ libraries to Python.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Canopy Wireless Networks.
Re-architected the Bandwidth Authentication Manager (BAM) from version 1.0 to 2.0
Design a XML to C compile-time web engine for the embedded Web server within the Canopy Radios.
